The '''Systech Quarter''' was a quarter of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:ES" /><ref name="TOR:ZS" /><ref name="TOR:Riot" /> The [[Network Security District]]<ref name="TOR:ES" /><ref name="TOR:ZS" /> and the [[High Security Lockdown]] were located within the quarter.<ref name="TOR:Riot" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Systech Quarter appeared on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The Systech Quarter did not properly appear on the Nar Shaddaa planetary map but was mentioned in several quests that placed locations of the Network Security District and High Security Lockdown within the quarter.<ref name="TOR:ES" /><ref name="TOR:ZS" /><ref name="TOR:Riot" />
